description_en: Updates the features of a cluster
name: UpdateHubClusterFeature

parameters.help_en: The fleet ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424404.html operation to obtain the ID of a created fleet instance
parameters.help_zh: 舰队ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424404.html接口获取已创建的舰队Fleet实例的ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The fleet name. The name must be 1 to 63 characters in length and can contain letters and digits. It must start with a letter and can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 舰队名称。长度为[1, 63]个英文或数字字符。必须以大小字母开头。可以包含数字、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable audit logging. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启审计日志。
true：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: audit_log_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Alibaba Cloud Service Mesh (ASM). Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启服务网格（ASM）。

true：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: enable_mesh

parameters.help_en:
The deletion protection property of the cluster. This parameter specifies whether the cluster can be deleted by using the console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424406.html operation. Valid values:
true: Deletion protection is enabled for the cluster.
false: Deletion protection is disabled for the cluster.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
集群删除保护属性，指定是否支持通过控制台或API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424406.html删除集群。

true：开启集群删除保护。
false：关闭集群删除保护。

默认值：false
parameters.name: deletion_protection

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to attach a public endpoint to the API server. Valid values:
true: An elastic IP address (EIP) is attached to the API server. When you need to attach an EIP, you can specify the ApiServerEipId parameter. If you do not specify this parameter, the system performs automatic creation of an EIP instance.
false: The EIP is detached from the API server
parameters.help_zh:
是否为API Server绑定公网入口。

true： 绑定公网EIP，需要绑定的时候，可以自行指定ApiServerEipId参数，若不传入，则系统会自动创建一个EIP实例。
false： 解绑公网EIP
parameters.name: public_api_server_enabled

parameters.help_en: The EIP instance ID
parameters.help_zh: EIP实例ID
parameters.name: api_server_eip_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Argo CD. This parameter takes effect only when the Profile parameter is set to XFlow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html operation to query the Profile parameter. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用ArgoCD。仅当Profile为XFlow时生效。Profile参数可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html接口查看。

本参数取值如下：
true：启用。
false：禁用
parameters.name: argo_cd_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the UI for workflow instances. This parameter takes effect only when the Profile parameter is set to XFlow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html operation to query the Profile parameter. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用工作流实例UI。仅当Profile为XFlow的时候生效。Profile参数可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html接口查看。

本参数取值如下：
true：启用。
false：禁用
parameters.name: argo_server_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The workflow scheduling mode. This parameter takes effect only when the Profile parameter is set to XFlow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html operation to query the Profile parameter. Valid values:
cost-optimized: cost-first.
stock-optimized: inventory-first
parameters.help_zh:
工作流调度模式。仅当Profile为XFlow的时候生效。Profile参数可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html接口查看。

本参数取值如下：
cost-optimized：成本优先。
stock-optimized：库存优先
parameters.name: workflow_schedule_mode

parameters.help_en: The price limit for workflow workloads. This parameter takes effect only when the WorkflowScheduleMode parameter is set to cost-optimized
parameters.help_zh: 工作流负载价格限制。仅当WorkflowScheduleMode取值为cost-optimized时生效
parameters.name: price_limit

parameters.help_en: The list of vSwitches
